Datasets

Evaluation metrics

●   Accuracy → % of observations that were correctly predicted?
●   Precision → % of predicted positive that were correct?
●   Recall → % of actually positive that were correct?
●   F1 score → score that is a function of precision and recall

Datasets

      WMT’14 English-French                                                                     WMT’14 English-German

Evaluation metrics

●   BLEU → quality of text translated, similar to “precision”
●   ROUGE → quality of text generated, similar to “recall”
●   Perplexity → quantiﬁes how ‘surprised’ the model is to see some words
    together

           Formulas can be found on this website: http://www.statmt.org/book/slides/08-evaluation.pdf

Tokenization summary

      Method                        Pros                        Cons

                       ●   Simple                  ●   Risk of OOV
     Word-level        ●   Interpretable           ●   Does not leverage
                                                       knowledge of root

   Subword-level       ●   Leverages common        ●   Risk of OOV, though less
                           preﬁxes and suﬃxes          than word-level
 e.g. WordPiece, BPE   ●   Learned from the data

                       ●   Small chance of OOV     ●   Makes computations slower
  Character-level      ●   RoBUsT tO CASinG anD    ●   Embeddings not
                           MIspeliNGs                  interpretable

Transformer architecture

                                                    Attention layer (MHA)

                                                      ●       Self-attention (Encoder-Encoder,
                                                              Decoder-Decoder)
                                                      ●       Encoder-Decoder attention layer

                                                    Feed Forward Neural Network (FFNN)

                                                    Positional Encoding (PE)

      Figure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.

Input

                                                           Overview

                                                             ●        Text is "tokenized"
                                                             ●        Learned embeddings for tokens

                                                           Parameters

                                                             ●        V: vocabulary size
                                                             ●        d_model: embedding dimensions

        Figure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.

... with a trick!

                                                  Positional encoding

                                                  Idea:

                                                    ●       Add position information to inputs
                                                    ●       Can be either learned or hardcoded

                                                                                                          +1                         max

                                                                              Position                         Position
                                                                                                                                     dot product

                                                                                                          -1                         min
                                                                                         Dimension                        Position
                                                  Goal: let model understand relative input position
       Left ﬁgure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.
       Right ﬁgures adapted from “Transformer Architecture: The Positional Encoding”, Kazemnejad, 2019.

Encoder

                                                       Overview

                                                         ●        Encoder-Encoder attention / self-attention
                                                         ●        Feed Forward Neural Network
                                                         ●        Normalization layer

                                                       Parameters

                                                         ●        N: layers stacked
                                                         ●        h: number of attention heads
                                                         ●        d_FF, d_key, d_value: sub-layer dimension
                                                         ●        d_model: embedding dimensions

     Figure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.

Output "shifted right"

                                                        Overview

                                                          ●        Learned embeddings for output tokens
                                                          ●        In practice, will start with [BOS] during
                                                                   translation

                                                        Parameters

                                                          ●        V: vocabulary size
                                                          ●        d_model: embedding dimensions

      Figure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.

Decoder

                                                      Overview

                                                         ●       Decoder-Decoder attention / self-attention
                                                         ●       Encoder-Decoder attention
                                                         ●       Feed Forward Neural Network
                                                         ●       Normalization layer

                                                      Parameters

                                                         ●       N: layers stacked
                                                         ●       h: number of attention heads
                                                         ●       d_FF, d_key, d_value: sub-layer dimension
                                                         ●       d_model: embedding dimensions

     Figure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.

Output

                                                       Overview

                                                         ●        Linear projection
                                                         ●        Classiﬁcation problem that outputs
                                                                  probability of belonging to a class, where
                                                                  class = word

                                                       Parameters

                                                         ●        V: vocabulary size
                                                         ●        d_model: embedding dimensions

     Figure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.

Computational tricks

                                                    Multi-head attention

                                                    Idea:

                                                      ●       Run multiple self-attention layers in parallel

                                                    Beneﬁts:

                                                      ●       Enables the model to capture diﬀerent
                                                              attention features in parallel
                                                      ●       Comparison: multiple ﬁlters of a convolutional
                                                              layer in computer vision

      Left ﬁgure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017. Right ﬁgure from “VIP cheatsheets for Stanford’s CS 230”, Amidi, 2019.

Computational tricks

                                                   Label smoothing

                                                   Idea:

                                                     ●       2015 vision paper: overconﬁdence is bad
                                                     ●       Introduce noise in true labels

                                                   Beneﬁts:

                                                     ●       General technique that prevents overﬁtting
                                                     ●       Improves accuracy and BLEU score

      Figure adapted from “Attention Is All You Need”, Vaswani et al., 2017.
